_about: 1-Propanol (1) + Propionic acid (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 101.3 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of 1-propanol, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Altman, E.[Ernesto], Stefanidis, G. D.[Georgios D.], Gerven, T. v.[Thomas van], Stankiewicz, A. I.[Andrzej I.], Phase Equilibria for Reactive Distillation of Propyl Propanoate. Pure Component Property Data, Vapor-Liquid Equilibria, and Liquid-Liquid Equilibria, J. Chem. Eng. Data 56 (2011) 2322-2328
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 7, 8. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.28 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
